exports.api.too_large.ka: ექსპორტი ძალიან დიდია (${row_count} ჩანაწერი, ზღვარი ${_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS}). დააზუსტეთ ფილტრი და სცადეთ თავიდან.
exports.api.too_large.en: The export is too large (${row_count} rows, limit ${_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS}). Narrow your filter and try again.
exports.api.too_large.context: HTTPException detail (text spans lines 46-47) when a requested export exceeds the server-side row cap.

exports.api.openpyxl_missing.ka: openpyxl ბიბლიოთეკა არ არის დაყენებული. გაუშვით: pip install openpyxl
exports.api.openpyxl_missing.en: The openpyxl library is not installed. Run: pip install openpyxl
exports.api.openpyxl_missing.context: HTTPException detail (503) when the XLSX export dependency is missing on the server. Contains a literal shell command, which a human should decide whether to keep untranslated/as-is in the Angular UI.

exports.xlsx.column_employee.context: XLSX column header for the compliance/mandatory-reading export.

exports.xlsx.column_material_type.context: XLSX column header. NOTE: the PDF export of the same report uses the shorter word 'ტიპი' (Type) instead — see exports.pdf.column_type — flagged in README as an inconsistency between the two export formats.

exports.xlsx.column_material_id.context: XLSX column header. The PDF variant uses just 'ID' — see exports.pdf.column_id.

exports.xlsx.column_read_date.context: XLSX column header. The PDF variant uses the shorter 'წაკითხვა' (Reading) — see exports.pdf.column_reading.

exports.api.reportlab_missing.ka: reportlab ბიბლიოთეკა არ არის დაყენებული. გაუშვით: pip install reportlab
exports.api.reportlab_missing.en: The reportlab library is not installed. Run: pip install reportlab
exports.api.reportlab_missing.context: HTTPException detail (503) when the PDF export dependency is missing. NOTE: a differently-worded, shorter message for the same underlying condition exists at exports.api.reportlab_missing_short — flagged in README.

exports.pdf.column_type.context: PDF column header, shorter than exports.xlsx.column_material_type.

exports.pdf.column_id.context: PDF column header (not actually Georgian text, included only for completeness of the header row).

exports.pdf.column_reading.context: PDF column header, shorter than exports.xlsx.column_read_date.

exports.pdf.title_mandatory_status.context: PDF report title for the mandatory-reading compliance export.

exports.api.reportlab_missing_short.context: HTTPException detail (503) for the team-stats PDF export specifically — a shorter variant of exports.api.reportlab_missing for the same underlying condition, flagged in README.

exports.team_stats.column_department.context: PDF column header for the team-statistics export.

exports.team_stats.column_total_assigned.context: PDF column header for the team-statistics export.

exports.team_stats.column_read.context: PDF column header for the team-statistics export.

exports.team_stats.pdf_title.context: PDF report title for the team-statistics export.

exports.api.not_ready.en: The export is not ready yet
exports.api.not_ready.context: HTTPException detail (still processing) when polling for a background export job that hasn't finished.
